status: provisional geometry and control experiment; not hardware specifications
notes: Beta adds the rotating sleeve to Alpha; no extra arm-base swivel or arm-assisted mobility.
Finger proximal/distal hinges receive synchronized commands; physical actuation coupling is undecided.
Bounded sleeve travel is an initial Alpha setting, not a limit imposed on future Model X.
No actuator has been selected; torque and speed limits are explicit assumptions.
The ring visual is hollow. Its collision proxy is a solid cylinder and ignores the directly connected parent, so bearing fit is not validated.
24 October user revision: two opposing curling fingers replace three radial fingers. Earlier three-finger grasp results are archived and do not transfer. Claw roll starts in Beta and remains in X.
gripper_design: Two opposing jointed curling fingers, on palm-local +/-X; front/back pinch in reference grasp posture

wrist_roll_plan.axis: Claw/palm local Z, along wrist-to-claw approach axis
wrist_roll_plan.implementation: Deferred to Beta; absent in Alpha
